Name: CLEAN MAP - GREENHOUSE
Author: Karbantms
Description:
[b]NOW IN GROWING COLLECTION![/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20952]CLEAN MAP - STANDARD FARM[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21249/]CLEAN MAP - BARN AND COOP[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21163]CLEAN MAP - GREENHOUSE[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21053]CLEAN MAP - QUARRY[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21263?tab=description]CLEAN MAP - CELLAR[/url]

[b]ADDED CONFIG AND NEW VARIATIONS! [/b]

[u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u]:
Not compatible with mods that alter greenhouse interior (Greenhouse.xnb).
Compatible with mods altering spritesheets used by greenhouse.

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]: (Just look at the images instead.)
Removed all clutter.
Entrance is now doubled and symmetrical!
Options for squared corners and farm plot size.

[u][b]Config[/b][/u]:
There are two options that are generated when you first load. Either edit config.json or be sane person and use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[list]
[*]Corners - Round/Square
[*]Farm plot - 10x12/12x12
[/list]You can change it anytime, just leave and enter greenhouse. If you are changing from 12x12 to 10x12 then remove everything below the farm plot and clear farming tiles.

"[i]What have you done! Map is too empty! You removed all the pretty details![/i]" - I know, main purpose of this mod is to allow players to decorate their buildable spaces as they want whether they use furniture or machines. (FACTORY MUST GROW... I mean sorry, wrong game...)

[i]I'm planning on making this a series of mods. I'm planning to edit the cellar, greenhouse, farm buildings, and other farms. Maybe even the farmhouse interior itself (I took a look and was horrified by what a jigsaw mess it is... So maybe later). Later I will make matching banners and make this site prettier.[/i]

If I overlooked some sprites or you have any ideas let me know (nature cut in half, wrong sprites, etc.).

Downloads.Description: *Added config and split this mod into 4 variations.
